name: Playground
summary: Welcome to Playground, the ultimate VR social experience where connection meets competition. Whether you're looking to kick back with friends or engage in thrilling soccer matches and other sports, Playground lets you dive into a virtual world designed for fun and interaction. Hang out, chat, and build new friendships in immersive social spaces, then team up or face off in adrenaline-pumping sports challenges.
